description: This file implements core functions for an 'Ansc Daemon Engine Tcp' object, including creation, initialization, and destruction, and manages socket operations and internal state for the TCP daemon engine component.

classes.name: ANSC_DAEMON_ENGINE_TCP_OBJECT
classes.description: A structure representing the TCP daemon engine object, containing state variables, function pointers, events, locks, and socket management data.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscDetoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new instance of the Ansc Daemon Engine Tcp object, setting up member function pointers and context handles.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDetoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the daemon engine object, stops ongoing operations, frees events and locks, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDetoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls all necessary subordinate objects for the TCP daemon engine, primarily by calling a base class function.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDetoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the TCP daemon engine object, setting default values for configuration parameters, creating events and locks, and preparing socket tables.
